title: Trump, Paul Weiss and the Capitulation of Big Law: 5 Takeaways
summary: The law firm Paul Weiss led the legal resistance against President Trump. Then it led a sudden retreat across the legal industry. A Times investigation examined how it caved to White House pressure.
